crossRefs.note: Moses said, “This is what Yahweh says: ‘About midnight I will go out into the middle of Egypt,
For I will go through the land of Egypt in that night, and will strike all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man…
The blood shall be to you for a token on the houses where you are. When I see the blood, I will pass over you, and no…
At midnight, Yahweh struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne…
Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt, for…
Behold, I myself will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they will go in after them. I will get myself honor over…
The Egyptians shall know that I am Yahweh when I have gotten myself honor over Pharaoh, over his chariots, and over his…
He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,
and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.
Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;
The king of Egypt was told that the people had fled; and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was changed toward…
The enemy said, ‘I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder. My desire will be satisfied on them. I will…
You blew with your wind. The sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.
Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot.
All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name, I cut them off.
“For truly, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against…
to do whatever your hand and your council foreordained to happen.
“At the time of the end the king of the south will contend with him; and the king of the north will come against him…
Yahweh will be seen over them; and his arrow will go flash like lightning; and the Lord Yahweh will blow the trumpet…
Come, let’s deal wisely with them, lest they multiply, and it happen that when any war breaks out, they also join…
Pharaoh commanded all his people, saying, “You shall cast every son who is born into the river, and every daughter you…
He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the…
Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;

translations.web: You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears. They came as a whirlwind to scatter me, gloating as if to devour the wretched in secret.
translations.bsb: With his own spear You pierced his head, when his warriors stormed out to scatter us, gloating as though ready to secretly devour the weak.
translations.kjv: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.
translations.asv: Thou didst pierce with his own staves the head of his warriors: They came as a whirlwind to scatter me; Their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.
